```{r}
metadata$Cohort_Lab <- paste(metadata$Cohort, metadata$Lab, sep = "_")
```


## #6 Gene alignment and subtracting control values

### Gene Alignment

```{r}
gene_list <- tAge:::load_gene_list()

e <- tAge:::.align_to_gene_list(eset, gene_list)
```

### Division by Groups

There will be 4 different groups to calculate the mean control value:

- All 55 controls

- By Cohort and Sex

- By Lab

- By Cohort and Lab

### Subtract_by function

```{r}
control_column <- "Intervention"
control_label  <- "Control"

subtract_by <- function(eset, group_cols = NULL, control_col, control_lab) {
  mat  <- Biobase::exprs(eset)
  meta <- Biobase::pData(eset)
  
  is_control <- meta[[control_col]] %in% control_lab
  group_id <- if (is.null(group_cols)) {
    rep("all", ncol(mat))
  } else {
    do.call(paste, c(meta[group_cols], sep = "_"))
  }
  
  out <- mat
  has_controls <- rep(TRUE, ncol(mat))
  
  for (g in unique(group_id)) {
    in_group   <- group_id == g
    ctrl_group <- in_group & is_control
    if (sum(ctrl_group) == 0) {
      has_controls[in_group] <- FALSE
      next
    }
    control_median <- apply(mat[, ctrl_group, drop = FALSE], 1, median, na.rm = TRUE)
    out[, in_group] <- mat[, in_group, drop = FALSE] - control_median
  }
  
  if (any(!has_controls)) {
    message(sum(!has_controls), " samples dropped (no controls in their group)")
  }
  
  Biobase::exprs(eset) <- out
  eset[, has_controls]
}
```

### Control Subtraction by groups

```{r}
groups <- list(
  All_Controls = NULL,
  Lab          = "Lab",
  Cohort_Sex   = "Cohort_Sex",
  Cohort_Lab   = "Cohort_Lab"
)

eset_by_group <- lapply(groups, function(cols) {
  subtract_by(e, cols, control_column, control_label)
})
```

### Subtract Controls from Expected_Hazard.log10

```{r}
center_by <- function(values, meta, group_cols = NULL, control_col, control_lab) {
  is_control <- meta[[control_col]] %in% control_lab
  group_id <- if (is.null(group_cols)) {
    rep("all", length(values))
  } else {
    do.call(paste, c(meta[group_cols], sep = "_"))
  }
  
  out <- values
  for (g in unique(group_id)) {
    in_group <- group_id == g
    control_median <- median(values[in_group & is_control], na.rm = TRUE)
    out[in_group] <- values[in_group] - control_median
  }
  out
}
```

## #7 Find the Models

```{r}
model_dir <- here("data","raw")

model_files <- list.files(model_dir, pattern = "\\.pkl$", full.names = TRUE)
basename(model_files)
```

### Confirm that the models are linear

```{r}
r <- rnorm(nrow(exprs(e)))

e2 <- e
exprs(e2) <- exprs(e) - r

for (model_path in model_files) {
  
    p1 <- predict_tAge(list(scaled_diff=e),  list(scaled_diff=model_path), species="mouse", mode="EN")
    p2 <- predict_tAge(list(scaled_diff=e2), list(scaled_diff=model_path), species="mouse", mode="EN")
    
    delta <- p1$scaled_diff_EN_tAge - p2$scaled_diff_EN_tAge
    
  cat(basename(model_path), ":", sd(delta), "\n")
}
```

## #8 Run the Models

```{r}
references <- c(
  Mortality_Rodents_Liver = "Expected_Hazard.log10",
  Mortality_Mouse_Multitissue = "Expected_Hazard.log10",
  Mortality_Rodents_Multitissue = "Expected_Hazard.log10"
)

results_list <- list()

for (group_name in names(eset_by_group)) {
  e_sub <- eset_by_group[[group_name]]
  meta_sub <- Biobase::pData(e_sub)
  
  for (model_name in names(references)) {
    model_path <- model_files[grepl(model_name, basename(model_files), fixed = TRUE)]
    if (length(model_path) != 1) {
      warning(model_name, ": ", length(model_path), " matching files, skipped")
      next
    }
    
    pred <- predict_tAge(
      list(scaled_diff = e_sub),
      list(scaled_diff = model_path),
      species = "mouse",
      mode ="EN"
    )
    
    pred_cols <- setdiff(colnames(pred), colnames(meta_sub))
    pred_col  <- pred_cols[!grepl("_sd$", pred_cols)][1]
    
    stopifnot(all(colnames(e_sub) %in% rownames(pred)))
    obtained <- pred[colnames(e_sub), pred_col]
    expected <- center_by(
      as.numeric(meta_sub[[references[[model_name]]]]),
      meta_sub,
      groups[[group_name]],
      control_column,
      control_label
    )
    difference <- obtained - expected
    
    block <- data.frame(
      Obtained   = obtained,
      Expected_Centered = expected,
      Difference = difference,
      Mean_Abs_Difference = NA_real_,
      Max_Abs_Difference  = NA_real_,
      SD_Difference       = NA_real_,
      Pearson  = NA_real_,
      Spearman = NA_real_,
      row.names = colnames(e_sub)
    )
    
    # summary metrics: only the first row of each block
    block$Mean_Abs_Difference[1] <- mean(abs(difference), na.rm = TRUE)
    block$Max_Abs_Difference[1]  <- max(abs(difference), na.rm = TRUE)
    block$SD_Difference[1]       <- sd(difference, na.rm = TRUE)
    block$Pearson[1]  <- cor(obtained, expected, use = "complete.obs", method = "pearson")
    block$Spearman[1] <- cor(obtained, expected, use = "complete.obs", method = "spearman")
    
    names(block) <- paste(group_name, model_name, names(block), sep = "__")
    results_list[[paste(group_name, model_name, sep = "__")]] <- block
  }
}
```

## #8.1 Run the Models without center_by

```{r}
# 8.1 d = previsão sem subtrair − Expected_Hazard.log10 (absoluto), por grupo

models <- c("Mortality_Rodents_Liver",
            "Mortality_Mouse_Multitissue",
            "Mortality_Rodents_Multitissue")
meta <- Biobase::pData(e)

# d de cada amostra, para um modelo
get_d <- function(model_name) {
  model_path <- model_files[grepl(model_name, basename(model_files), fixed = TRUE)]
  stopifnot(length(model_path) == 1)
  
  pred <- predict_tAge(list(scaled_diff = e), list(scaled_diff = model_path),
                       species = "mouse", mode = "EN")
  pred_cols <- setdiff(colnames(pred), colnames(meta))
  pred_col  <- pred_cols[!grepl("_sd$", pred_cols)][1]
  
  samples  <- colnames(e)
  obtained <- as.numeric(pred[samples, pred_col])
  expected <- as.numeric(meta[samples, "Expected_Hazard.log10"])
  setNames(obtained - expected, samples)
}

d_list <- lapply(setNames(models, models), get_d)

# identificador de grupo de cada amostra
group_id <- function(cols, m) {
  if (is.null(cols)) rep("all", nrow(m)) else do.call(paste, c(m[cols], sep = "_"))
}

# N, média e desvio-padrão de d dentro de cada grupo
d_summary <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(d_list), function(model_name) {
  d <- d_list[[model_name]]
  m <- meta[names(d), , drop = FALSE]
  do.call(rbind, lapply(names(groups), function(group_name) {
    id <- group_id(groups[[group_name]], m)
    data.frame(
      Model    = model_name,
      Grouping = group_name,
      Group    = names(tapply(d, id, length)),
      N        = as.integer(tapply(d, id, length)),
      Mean_d   = as.numeric(tapply(d, id, mean)),
      SD_d     = as.numeric(tapply(d, id, sd))
    )
  }))
}))

# um desvio-padrão por regra de controlo (junta os grupos)
pooled_sd <- function(df) {
  ok <- df$N > 1
  sqrt(sum((df$N[ok] - 1) * df$SD_d[ok]^2) / sum(df$N[ok] - 1))
}

key <- paste(d_summary$Model, d_summary$Grouping, sep = "__")
d_pooled <- do.call(rbind, lapply(split(d_summary, key), function(df) {
  data.frame(Model = df$Model[1], Grouping = df$Grouping[1],
             N_Groups = nrow(df), Pooled_SD = pooled_sd(df))
}))

print(d_summary, row.names = FALSE)   # d por grupo
print(d_pooled,  row.names = FALSE)   # SD por regra, para comparar
```

## #9 Results Table

```{r}
aligned_blocks <- lapply(results_list, function(b) {
  out <- b[rownames(metadata), , drop = FALSE]
  rownames(out) <- NULL
  out
})

expected_centered <- sapply(names(groups), function(g) {
  center_by(
    as.numeric(metadata[["Expected_Hazard.log10"]]),
    metadata,
    groups[[g]],
    control_column,
    control_label
  )
})
colnames(expected_centered) <- paste0(names(groups), "__Expected_Hazard.log10_centered")

results_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = rownames(metadata),
  metadata,
  expected_centered,
  " " = NA,
  do.call(cbind, unname(aligned_blocks)),
  check.names = FALSE,
  row.names = NULL
)

write.csv(results_table,
          here("experiments","replication","tAge_replication_results.csv"),
          na="",
          row.names= FALSE
          )
```

## #10 Graphs

```{r}
plot_data <- do.call(rbind, lapply(names(aligned_blocks), function(key) {
  parts <- strsplit(key, "__")[[1]]
  data.frame(
    Control_Group = parts[1],
    Model    = parts[2],
    Sample   = rownames(metadata),
    Obtained = aligned_blocks[[key]][[paste(key, "Obtained", sep = "__")]],
    Expected = aligned_blocks[[key]][[paste(key, "Expected_Centered", sep = "__")]],
    Lab      = metadata$Lab
  )
}))

# Pearson r per panel, shown in the corner
panel_stats <- do.call(rbind, lapply(
  split(plot_data, list(plot_data$Control_Group, plot_data$Model), drop = TRUE),
  function(d) {
    data.frame(
      Control_Group = d$Control_Group[1],
      Model = d$Model[1],
      label = sprintf("r = %.2f", cor(d$Obtained, d$Expected, use = "complete.obs"))
    )
  }
))

scatter_plot <- ggplot(plot_data, aes(x = Expected, y = Obtained, colour = Lab)) +
  geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = "dashed", colour = "grey50") +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.7, size = 1.8, na.rm = TRUE) +
  geom_text(
    data = panel_stats, aes(label = label),
    x = -Inf, y = Inf, hjust = -0.1, vjust = 1.5,
    inherit.aes = FALSE, size = 3.5
  ) +
  facet_grid(Control_Group ~ Model) +
  labs(
    x = "Expected hazard (log10)",
    y = "Obtained hazard (log10)",
    title = "Obtained vs expected hazard by control group and model"
  ) +
  theme_bw()

scatter_plot

ggsave(here("experiments","replication","tAge_scatterplots.png"),
  scatter_plot, width = 14, height = 11, dpi = 300
)
```
